title: How olive oil is produced
prompt: The diagram below shows the stages in the production of olive oil. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

steps.label: Harvesting
steps.detail: Ripe olives are shaken from the trees onto nets in autumn

steps.label: Sorting
steps.detail: Leaves and twigs are removed by a blower

steps.label: Washing
steps.detail: The olives are rinsed in cold water

steps.label: Crushing
steps.detail: Stone wheels grind whole olives, including the stones, into a paste

steps.label: Mixing
steps.detail: The paste is stirred slowly for 30 minutes so that droplets of oil join together

steps.label: Pressing
steps.detail: The paste is spread on mats and pressed to release liquid

steps.label: Separating
steps.detail: A centrifuge spins the liquid to separate oil from water

steps.label: Storing
steps.detail: The oil rests in steel tanks for a month so that sediment settles

steps.label: Bottling
steps.detail: The oil is filtered and put into dark glass bottles

title: Recycling glass bottles
prompt: The diagram below shows how glass bottles are recycled. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

steps.label: Collection
steps.detail: Used bottles are left at collection points and taken away by lorry

steps.label: Sorting by colour
steps.detail: Clear, green and brown glass are separated at the recycling plant

steps.label: Cleaning
steps.detail: High-pressure water removes labels and dirt

steps.label: Crushing
steps.detail: The glass is broken into small pieces

steps.label: Melting
steps.detail: The pieces are heated in a furnace at 1,500 degrees until liquid

steps.label: Moulding
steps.detail: The liquid glass is blown into moulds to form new bottles

steps.label: Cooling
steps.detail: The bottles are cooled slowly to stop them cracking

steps.label: Filling
steps.detail: The new bottles are delivered to drinks factories and filled

steps.label: Sale
steps.detail: The bottles are sent to shops and sold to customers

title: How paper is made from wood
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which paper is made from wood. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

steps.label: Felling
steps.detail: Trees are cut down in managed forests and the branches removed

steps.label: Transport
steps.detail: Logs are carried to the paper mill by lorry

steps.label: Removing bark
steps.detail: Logs turn in a large drum which strips off the bark

steps.label: Chipping
steps.detail: The logs are cut into small chips

steps.label: Pulping
steps.detail: The chips are cooked with chemicals and water to make pulp

steps.label: Cleaning and bleaching
steps.detail: The pulp is washed and whitened

steps.label: Forming
steps.detail: The pulp is sprayed onto a moving wire screen and water drains away

steps.label: Pressing and drying
steps.detail: Heated rollers squeeze and dry the sheet

steps.label: Rolling
steps.detail: The finished paper is wound onto large reels

steps.label: Cutting
steps.detail: Reels are cut into sheets and packed

title: How a hydroelectric power station works
prompt: The diagram below shows how electricity is generated in a hydroelectric power station. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

steps.label: Reservoir
steps.detail: A dam holds back river water in a high reservoir

steps.label: Intake
steps.detail: Gates in the dam open and water enters a large pipe

steps.label: Descent
steps.detail: Water flows down the pipe, gaining speed

steps.label: Turbine
steps.detail: The moving water turns the blades of a turbine

steps.label: Generator
steps.detail: The turbine drives a generator, which produces electricity

steps.label: Transformer
steps.detail: The voltage is raised for long-distance transmission

steps.label: Power lines
steps.detail: Cables carry the electricity to towns and factories

steps.label: Outflow
steps.detail: The water leaves the turbine and returns to the river below the dam

steps.label: Pumping at night
steps.detail: When demand is low, spare electricity pumps water back up to the reservoir

title: How instant coffee is produced
prompt: The diagram below shows how instant coffee is produced. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

steps.label: Picking
steps.detail: Ripe coffee cherries are picked by hand

steps.label: Drying
steps.detail: The cherries are spread out in the sun for two weeks

steps.label: Hulling
steps.detail: A machine removes the dried skin to leave green beans

steps.label: Roasting
steps.detail: The beans are roasted at 200 degrees until dark brown

steps.label: Grinding
steps.detail: The roasted beans are ground into coarse powder

steps.label: Brewing
steps.detail: The grounds are mixed with hot water and the liquid is strained

steps.label: Freezing
steps.detail: The strong coffee is frozen into a thin sheet at minus 40 degrees

steps.label: Breaking
steps.detail: The frozen sheet is broken into granules

steps.label: Vacuum drying
steps.detail: The granules pass through a vacuum so that the ice turns straight to vapour

steps.label: Packing
steps.detail: The dry granules are sealed in jars

title: The life cycle of the salmon
prompt: The diagram below shows the life cycle of the salmon. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

chart.title: The life cycle of the salmon

steps.label: Eggs
steps.detail: In autumn, eggs are laid in gravel in the upper part of a river

steps.label: Hatching
steps.detail: After about three months the eggs hatch into tiny fish that stay hidden in the gravel

steps.label: Fry
steps.detail: The young fish emerge and feed on insects in shallow, fast water

steps.label: Parr
steps.detail: For one to three years they grow in the river, marked with dark bars

steps.label: Smolt
steps.detail: They turn silver and swim downstream to the river mouth

steps.label: Ocean life
steps.detail: Adults spend one to four years feeding at sea, growing to 70 cm or more

steps.label: Return
steps.detail: Adults swim back up the river where they were born, leaping over waterfalls

steps.label: Spawning
steps.detail: Females dig nests in the gravel and lay eggs; most adults then die
